notes: Page names Axeman-Anderson Company as parent. Year table is limited to the three codes the page lists (LT 2020, LK 2021, LM 2022); the page states pre-2020 systems used numbers but gives no examples, so anything outside the table returns cannot-determine rather than a guessed year. Month and week appear only as a color legend (Year RED, Month GREEN, Week BLUE) for the image and are not encoded. Year = 1st & 2nd letters of the serial: letter-sequence counting (page example 6LKK000043076 has letters L,K,K, so LK = 2021); character positions 1-2 would read '6L', which is not a letter code. No held styles on this page.

styles.era: 13-character serials, digit, 3 letters, 9 digits; 2020-2022 codes as listed
styles.notes: Page: year determined by the 1st & 2nd letters of the serial number; limited information table LT = 2020, LK = 2021, LM = 2022. Positions are the first two letters, i.e. character indices 1-2 in the example shape.
